fix(core): late text waits for paste-last; recovery stays local; wait…

…ing audio read back from disk (#59)

A waiting Dictation's text, and a recovered one's, now lands untyped for
paste-last, as the spec's never-lose rule says for text that arrives late.
Recovered runs get no CloudAccess: whether the Dictation began in Private
mode was decided at fn-down and not kept. A retry rebuilds its plan from
today's settings, keeps the cloud only if fn-down and now both allow it,
re-checks the row after transcribing, and keeps going if a .waiting write
was dropped. A waiting clip that is whole on disk is read back per try
instead of held in RAM, and CAF reads run off the Conductor's actor.

asynchronously, a few ms after fn-down. A kill inside that window leaves
neither, costing less audio than the 0.1 s a crash may lose; the check
script hit it once. Any later kill must still leave a row.

failed read look like a deleted row: one SQLite error stopped the retry,
and after a transcription dropped the text until the next launch.
History.owesText says false only for a row that is gone or has text.
